Measured pathogen load with unit, e.g. copies/mL (UCUM).
Molecular procedure used (SNOMED CT).
The specialisations of a microbiological investigation. Each specialisation adds its specific attributes to the common information inherited from MII_LM_Mikrobio_Untersuchung.
Culture-based and microscopic investigations and the subsequent susceptibility testing.
Result of an untargeted microbiological culture that checks whether any microorganism grows in the specimen.
Coding of the investigation; fixed here: detection of a microorganism by culture (LOINC).
Growth or no growth in the specimen (SNOMED CT). An indeterminable result is represented not here but via the data absent reason.
Culture procedure used (SNOMED CT).
Morphological observation of microorganisms by microscopic examination. The result is a morphological group, not a species.
Coding of the investigation; microscopic observation (LOINC).
Observed morphology (SNOMED CT).
How much of the reported finding was seen: as a semiquantitative grade (SNOMED CT) or as a count per field of view (UCUM).
Microscopic procedure used (SNOMED CT). The staining technique is stated alongside.
Microscopic detection of an object named in the investigation code; the quantity seen is stated alongside.
Coding of the object sought and the staining technique (LOINC, ordinal scale).
Detection or exclusion of the object sought (SNOMED CT).
How much of the detected object was seen: as a semiquantitative grade (SNOMED CT) or as a count per field of view (UCUM).
Microscopic procedure used (SNOMED CT).
Qualitative microscopic assessment of the suitability of sputum specimens for culture based on the ratio of inflammatory to epithelial cells.
Coding of the investigation; fixed here: Bartlett score (LOINC).
Score category and the specimen suitability derived from it (LOINC).
Procedure used; fixed here: microscopy (SNOMED CT).
Gram-stain-based semiquantitative scoring system for assessing vaginal microbiota patterns in bacterial vaginosis.
Coding of the investigation; fixed here: Nugent score (LOINC).
Score value of the Nugent score (dimensionless).
Procedure used; fixed here: microscopy (SNOMED CT).
Quantitative determination of viable microorganisms in a specimen as colony-forming units per volume or mass.
Coding of the colony count (LOINC).
Measured colony count with unit, e.g. CFU/mL (UCUM).
Semiquantitative classification of the measured value, e.g. scant / moderate / abundant growth.
Procedure used; fixed here: counting (SNOMED CT).

Antimicrobial substance tested and test procedure (LOINC). Codes without a pre-coordinated specimen type are preferred.

Categorical assessment of the measured value (susceptible / intermediate / resistant).
Susceptibility category of the pathogen tested.
Interpretive standard including version on whose breakpoints the category is based, e.g. EUCAST or CLSI.
Identification or detection of a microorganism or infectious agent in a specimen.
Identification of a microorganism or infectious agent without restriction to a predefined target.

Identified microorganism or agent (SNOMED CT).
Detection or identification procedure used (SNOMED CT).

Coding of the target sought and the test procedure (LOINC). Codes without a pre-coordinated specimen type are preferred.
Detection result for the target sought (SNOMED CT).
Detection procedure used (SNOMED CT).
Cycle threshold in nucleic acid detection, e.g. real-time PCR.
Coding of the Ct value for the respective target (LOINC). Codes without a pre-coordinated specimen type are preferred.
Cycle threshold (dimensionless).
Procedure used; fixed here: real-time PCR (SNOMED CT).
Investigation from which the Ct value originated, usually the associated specific determination.
Additional properties of a detected pathogen, in particular regarding virulence and resistance.
Qualitative detection or exclusion of virulence determinants in a specimen.
Coding of the virulence determinant investigated (LOINC).
Detected or not detected (SNOMED CT).
Detection of resistance genes or resistance mutations as an indication of a specific resistance mechanism.
Coding of the resistance gene or resistance mechanism investigated (LOINC).
Detected or not detected (SNOMED CT).
Detection procedure used (SNOMED CT).
Classification of multidrug-resistant Gram-negative pathogens according to the RKI categorisation.

Predicted susceptibility or resistance to antimicrobial substances derived from genotypic detections.

Investigations from which the assessment was derived: identification, susceptibility and resistance mechanisms.

Categorical classification of avidity, e.g. low or high.

Quantitative measurements of pathogen-specific analytes.
Quantitative measurement of pathogen-specific antigens or antibodies by immunological procedures.

Measured concentration or activity with unit (UCUM).

Semiquantitative measurement from serial dilution series, reported as a ratio, e.g. 1:160.
